injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

manifestations.description: stiffness of the left index finger
loss of sensation over ulnar side of the left index finger
pain over dorsum of the left hand thereby limiting left wrist extension
local tenderness over dorsum of the radio-carpal joint
various small scars in the left index finger
deformity of index finger with angulation to the ulnar side
rotational deformity of distal part of the index finger leading to more severe ulnar deviation on the flexion of the index finger

losses.description: various small scars in the left index finger
residual stiffness of the left index finger and limited left wrist extension
rotational deformity and angulation of the left index finger with loss of sensation over ulnar side
